items.title: Louie Bellson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Right back I’d say the same thing. I found him easy to work with. He had the right attitude. We were playing great music. We worked together.

ctx.x: Right back I’d say the same thing. I found him easy to work with. He had the right attitude. We were playing great music. We worked together. You can’t beat that combination, working together. If you have a problem, you solve it right there. Don’t let it ride over and be a part of your ugly side. Do what you have to do, and do it the best you can. That’s what he did. He was a good bass player too. I saw him not too long ago. They had a get-together of all the people that worked with Duke. Singers – Herb Jeffries…
